rows.note: This is the all-purpose pattern for having an allergy to a substance or animal.

example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 faa1 saang1 gwo3 man5

rows.note: Use this for strong emotional aversion, such as being allergic to homework in the figurative sense.

example.traditional: 我一諗起要做功課就反感。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 nam2 hei2 jiu3 zou6 gung1 fo3 zau6 faan2 gam2
